info.name: Hansel
info.ability: Each night, choose another player. If an evil player's ability targets them, learn the team of one source.
info.lore: A watchful brother who overhears his parents' plan and fills his pockets with white pebbles to follow their moonlit gleam. During the second abandonment he drops crumbs, and when the Witch cages him, he fools her poor sight with a little bone.

cues.body: Hansel chooses another player and marks them with a White Pebble.
Hansel chooses another player and receives any pending source-team information at dawn.

info.name: Gretel
info.ability: Once per game, publicly choose a player. If they register as a Killer, they die; otherwise, you die.
info.lore: A resolute sister forced to serve the Witch while Hansel remains caged. She pretends not to understand how to enter the oven, pushes the old woman inside when she bends down to demonstrate, and then frees her brother.

presentation.label: Gretel accuses
presentation.title: Gretel
presentation.description: Publicly choose a player and check whether they register as a Killer.

info.name: Woodcutter
info.ability: Each night, protect a player. On the first day, you cannot speak or vote; if you speak, you die.
info.lore: A poor woodcutter who loves his children but twice yields to fear of famine and leads them into the forest. He grieves after their departure and receives them in tears when they return with the Witch's riches.

cues.body: The Woodcutter chooses a player to protect.
The Woodcutter chooses a player to protect.

presentation.label: The Woodcutter has spoken
presentation.title: The Woodcutter
presentation.description: The Woodcutter has spoken. What do you want to do?

info.name: Starving Mother
info.ability: Each night, plague a player other than last night's target. They cannot use their ability, speak, vote, or nominate through the following day.
info.lore: When great scarcity falls upon the land, she persuades the Woodcutter to leave the children where the forest is thickest. She lights them a fire, gives each a piece of bread, and trusts they will never find the road home.

cues.body: The Starving Mother chooses a player to plague, then wakes them for the private status notice.
She chooses a player other than last night's target, then wakes them for the private status notice.

value.value: Sin habilidad · Sin hablar · Sin votar · Sin nominar

presentation.title: You are plagued
presentation.description: You cannot use your ability, speak, vote, or nominate while this state lasts.

info.name: Oven Witch
info.ability: Each night, feed two players. A protected target gains no new mark. A player dies when receiving their third Feeding mark.
info.lore: A dim-sighted, keen-scented old woman who builds a house of bread and sugar to lure children. She cages Hansel to fatten him, forces Gretel to labour, and heats the oven in which she means to cook them.

cues.body: The Oven Witch chooses two players to feed.
Choose two players, advance their Feeding marks, and resolve any threshold deaths.

info.name: White Bird
info.ability: Each night, learn a player's team. You win personally if you survive after guiding at least one {{team:grimm:ayudante}} and one {{team:grimm:pueblo}}.
info.lore: A snow-white bird whose song halts the children after three days of wandering. When its song ends, it flies ahead of them and leads them to the house made of bread, cake, and sugar.

cues.body: The White Bird chooses a player and learns their team.
The White Bird chooses a player and learns their team.

effects.reason: El Pájaro Blanco sobrevivió tras guiar al menos a un Ayudante y un Pueblerino.

info.name: River Duck
info.ability: Once per game, prevent a voted execution. The saved player becomes Plagued and cannot use their ability, speak, vote, or nominate until the next dawn.
info.lore: A white duck that comes when a river bars Hansel and Gretel's journey home. It carries them one at a time because Gretel refuses to burden it with both together, opening the final road back to their father.

value.value: Sin habilidad · Sin hablar · Sin votar · Sin nominar

presentation.title: You are plagued
presentation.description: You cannot use your ability, speak, vote, or nominate while this state lasts.

presentation.label: The Duck rescues
presentation.title: The River Duck
presentation.description: When a voted execution is about to resolve, save its candidate: they become Plagued until the next dawn.

info.name: Rooftop Cat
info.ability: Once per game at night, choose two players. Targeted abilities aimed at either affect the other. You win personally if you survive.
info.lore: The white figure Hansel pretends to watch upon his roof while secretly dropping pebbles. The distraction blinds his parents to the shining trail that will guide the children home.

cues.body: The Cat may choose two players to swap.
If unused, the Cat may choose two players to swap.

effects.reason: El Gato del Tejado sobrevive al final de la partida.

info.name: Forest Hunter
info.ability: Each night, mark a player. If another player nominates them the next day, you may kill them immediately. Win personally after killing a {{team:grimm:oscuro}} and a {{team:grimm:siervo}} player. If you are in play, at least one {{team:grimm:siervo}} must be in play.
info.lore: A solitary hunter born from the dangers surrounding the great forest. He knows the tracks of beasts and those who prey upon travellers, and has learned to decide swiftly who poses a threat when hunger has erased every law.

cues.body: The Hunter marks a player as quarry.
The Hunter marks a player as quarry.

presentation.description: Another player nominated {playerName}. Ask the Hunter whether they want that player to die.

effects.reason: El Cazador del Bosque mató al menos un personaje de cada equipo requerido.

info.name: Elder of the Roads
info.ability: Each night, protect a player from becoming Plagued. You cannot choose the same player two nights in a row.
info.lore: An old woman imagined among villages afflicted by scarcity. She saves part of her meagre bread for travellers, and knows the shelters that can keep a {{team:grimm:errante}} from being left alone in the forest.

cues.body: The Elder protects one player from becoming Plagued.
She protects a different player from becoming Plagued.

info.name: Fire Spirit
info.ability: Each night, mark a player with fire; their second mark kills them. If the Oven Witch dies, you die.
info.lore: The living shape of the flames that heat the Witch's oven. It feeds upon the wood Gretel must carry and its mistress's cruelty; when the old woman burns, the spirit's fate is sealed with hers.

cues.body: The Fire Spirit marks a player with Fire.
Advance one player's Fire mark and resolve any threshold death.

info.name: Bird Shepherd
info.ability: Each night, choose two players and learn whether they belong to the same team.
info.lore: Keeper of the countless birds that descend upon Hansel's second trail. Their beaks devour every breadcrumb and erase the only path the children knew back to their home.

cues.body: The Shepherd chooses two players and learns Same or Different.
The Shepherd chooses two players and learns Same or Different.

presentation.title: Do they belong to the same team?

info.name: Midwife
info.ability: Once per game, declare a player innocent. If they are {{team:grimm:pueblo}}, protect them from execution and becoming Plagued; otherwise, you die.
info.lore: A woman imagined in the Woodcutter's {{team:grimm:pueblo}}, accustomed to attending births when even bread is scarce. She knows the families suffering through the famine and stands against those who would make children pay for adult hunger.

presentation.label: The Midwife declares
presentation.title: The Midwife
presentation.description: Publicly choose a player and record whether they belong to the Village.

info.name: Crow of the Last Loaves
info.ability: Each night, mark a player with Hunger. When they receive their second mark, they cannot use their ability the following day. If the Starving Mother is dead, you lose this ability; existing marks remain.
info.lore: A black bird born from the hunger circling the Woodcutter's house, stealing the last crusts. Its presence turns scarcity into despair and accompanies the Mother's decision to abandon those she can no longer feed.

cues.body: The Crow chooses a player and advances their Hunger mark.
If the Starving Mother lives, the Crow chooses a player and advances their Hunger mark.

text.name: Hansel and Gretel
text.tagline: Pebbles, hunger, and a burning oven: find the way home before the forest devours you.
text.description: A playable adaptation of Hansel and Gretel with Village, Helper, Wanderer, Servant, and Dark teams.
